item.title: Mikaela Shiffrin’s giant slalom at Milan Cortina ended without a medal but plenty of optimism
item.description: So while the leaderboard near the finish line during Sunday’s GS needed to flip to the second page before Shiffrin’s name appeared in 11th, the most decorated skier in the history of the sport didn’t view her finish as a disappointment.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn is preparing to fly home to the US with more surgeries to come, team official tells AP
item.description: American Lindsey Vonn was preparing to fly back to her home country on Sunday after her terrifying head-over-heels crash in the Olympic downhill, the U.S. Ski Team’s chief told The Associated Press.

item.title: Mandatory driver impairment sensors clear a funding hurdle, but are they ready?
item.description: A federal law requiring impairment-detection devices inside all new cars survived a recent push to strip its funding but remains stalled by questions about whether the technology is ready.

item.title: Colorado weather: Power outages possible amid high winds, ‘critical’ fire danger
item.description: Coloradans on the Front Range and Eastern Plains may see another round of power outages this week as electricity utilities ramp up safety features amid widespread fire danger.

item.title: Colorado weather: More than a foot of snow forecast for mountains this week
item.description: While the Front Range and Eastern Plains battle critical fire danger this week, Colorado's mountains are on track to see more than a foot of snow, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: Denver breaks heat record Sunday; temperatures 22 degrees above normal
item.description: Temperatures at DIA reached 68 degrees on Sunday, breaking the previous Feb. 15 heat record of 67 degrees set in 2017, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: Colorado’s Bangot Dak, Sebastian Rancik get back on track at BYU
item.description: The recent play of Bangot Dak and Sebastian Rancik certainly aren’t the only reasons Colorado has found itself in a rut lately.

item.title: Anthony Edwards claims MVP award, leads Stars to tourney win in an entertaining NBA All-Star Game
item.description: Anthony Edwards won the Most Valuable Player award while leading his “Stars” team past their fellow Americans on the “Stripes” team 47-21 to win the final of the NBA All-Star Game on Sunday.

item.title: Brush fire sparks along I-70 in Colorado from house engulfed in flames
item.description: A Silver Plume house fire that sparked Sunday afternoon quickly spread to the nearby brush along Interstate 70, according to Clear Creek County officials.
